The latest version of React is **19.3**, according to the page. It's the current version shown on react.dev, and its release is listed as **v19.3.0 (September 9, 2026)**, with a dedicated [React 19.3 blog post](/blog/2026/09/09/react-19-3).

The docs are maintained within major versions, so react.dev covers React 19, including 19.3. Previous majors are archived at 18.react.dev, 17.react.dev, 16.react.dev, and 15.react.dev.
